subject: 📝 Your specialist referral has been updated (Ref #$referral_id)
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your specialist referral has been updated by $updated_by. The changes are listed below so you can see exactly what is different.

=== WHAT CHANGED ===
$change_list

=== YOUR REFERRAL AS IT STANDS NOW ===
Reference Number: $referral_id
Specialty: $specialty
Specialist: $specialist_provider
Referring Provider: $referring_provider
Urgency: $urgency
Date Referred: $referral_date
Appointment Date: $appointment_date
Current Status: $status

Reason for referral:
$reason

Notes:
$notes

Updated On: $updated_at

=== DO YOU NEED TO DO ANYTHING? ===
If the specialty, specialist or appointment date changed, check that the new details still work for you and contact the Health Centre if they do not. If only the notes or reason changed, no action is needed.

=== IF THIS IS NOT RIGHT ===
If you did not expect these changes, contact the Health Centre quoting reference $referral_id. Any change can be reversed.

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Health Centre: health@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Best regards,
University Health Centre

$signature
